output.subject: Your call about the app and website outage
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us about the problems you had with our app and website. You told us you had been unable to use either since the morning, and that you needed to send your rent payment by 5pm that same day. We understand how stressful it is to face a deadline like that and not be able to reach your money the way you normally would. We're sorry for the frustration and worry this has caused.

You mentioned that during the call you were offered the option of making the transfer by phone, and that you preferred to wait and send the payment through the app once access was restored. We want to make sure you were able to send your rent and that your app and website access is working properly again.

Our Digital Banking team will review what you've told us and respond within 10 business days. If you are still having trouble getting into the app or website, or if anything about your rent payment remains unresolved, please contact us and let us know.

Thank you for your patience while we look into this.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Time-sensitive: the rent deadline was the day of the call, well before any 10-business-day reply; consider proactive contact.
Confirm whether the customer's rent payment was sent, and when.
Confirm the outage has been resolved and the customer's access works.
The call note contains an unexplained ⟦NAME_1⟧ token in 'CX ⟦NAME_1⟧ WAIT FOR APP'; confirm what the customer actually chose.
Check whether the customer faces a late rent charge and decide whether to address it (they did not ask for anything beyond restored access).
The draft does not repeat the rep's early-afternoon restoration estimate; add outage details if appropriate.
